sentences.en: Many birds regurgitate food to feed their chicks.
sentences.zh: 许多鸟类会反胃吐出食物来喂养雏鸟。

sentences.en: After eating too much, he felt the need to regurgitate his meal.
sentences.zh: 吃完太多后，他感觉需要把饭吐出来。

sentences.en: The teacher asked the student to regurgitate what was taught in class.
sentences.zh: 老师让这位学生复述一下课上讲的内容。
